title: Endpoint Catalog Entry Schema
description: Normalized endpoint/capability catalog for trading data providers. Each entry describes a single provider endpoint or data capability with enough detail for automated adapter generation, React table rendering, and API ingestion.

$meta.description: Catalog-level metadata — source provenance, extraction date, schema version.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this schema (NOT the data). Bump on breaking field changes.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this catalog was generated/last updated.

generatedBy.description: Tool or process that generated this catalog (e.g. 'extract-endpoints.cjs').

sourceFiles.description: Files this catalog was derived from (plugin PHP, docs, public API docs URLs).

confidenceScoring.description: Explanation of the confidence levels used throughout this catalog.

confirmed.description: Verified against provider docs or live API testing.

likely.description: Inferred from known patterns, public docs, or community sources but not directly tested.

uncertain.description: Best-guess based on limited information; needs verification.

unknown.description: Explicitly unknown; field is null with a reason.

providers.description: Map of provider IDs to their endpoint catalog entries.

rateLimitCategories.description: Reusable rate-limit category definitions. Providers reference these by key.

payloadClasses.description: Reusable payload class definitions. Endpoints reference these by key.

providerId.description: Machine-friendly slug matching the provider ID in provider-comparisons.seed.json. Lowercase, underscores for separators.

providerType.description: Brokerage = can execute trades. Data-only = market data only. Hybrid = both but different tiers.

adapterStatus.description: Implementation status in the Nest adapter layer.

isMockOnly.description: True if adapter returns mock data even with credentials present.

method.description: Authentication method used by the provider API.

credentialFields.description: Environment variable / secret names needed. e.g. ['ALPACA_API_KEY', 'ALPACA_API_SECRET']

headerName.description: If method is api_key_header or bearer_token, the header name (e.g. 'Authorization', 'X-API-KEY').

tokenPrefix.description: If bearer token, the prefix before the token value (e.g. 'Bearer').

paper.description: Base URL for paper/sandbox/demo environment, or null if not available.

endpoints.description: Ordered list of cataloged endpoints for this provider.

capabilityMatrix.description: Cross-reference keys back to the provider-comparisons.seed.json capability fields for traceability.

method.description: HTTP method. Use 'WS' for WebSocket endpoints.

path.description: URL path relative to base URL. Use {placeholder} for path parameters. Always starts with /.

category.description: Functional category for grouping in UI and adapter routing.

displayName.description: Human-readable short label for React table rendering.

description.description: One-line description of what this endpoint returns.

payloadClass.description: Key into the top-level payloadClasses map. Describes the response shape.

timeframeSupport.description: For candle/bar endpoints: supported timeframes. Empty array if not a candles endpoint.

rateLimitCategory.description: Key into the top-level rateLimitCategories map. Describes the rate limit for this specific endpoint.

parameters.description: Required and optional parameters for this endpoint.

paginationSupport.description: Pagination strategy supported by this endpoint.

maxPageSize.description: Maximum items per page, or null if not paginated.

deprecated.description: True if endpoint is deprecated by the provider.

burstAllowance.description: Maximum concurrent or short-burst requests allowed.

headersProvided.description: Whether the provider returns X-RateLimit-* headers.

costPerRequest.description: If provider uses a 'cost' model per endpoint (e.g. weighted requests).

exampleKeys.description: Top-level keys in the JSON response for this payload shape.

schemaType.description: Root JSON type of the response.

freshnessSLA.description: Freshness expectations for data returned by this endpoint/provider.

expectedLatencyMs.description: Expected data latency from market event to API delivery, in milliseconds.

staleThresholdMinutes.description: Minutes after which cached data is considered stale for this endpoint.

updateFrequency.description: How frequently the provider updates this data.

marketHoursOnly.description: True if data only flows during market hours.

confidence.description: Confidence level for this field. confirmed=verified against provider docs or live testing, likely=inferred from patterns/public docs, uncertain=best-guess limited info, unknown=explicitly null.
